project.description: The common error-code standard (plain Java, no dependencies; package com.documentplatform.errors): PlatformCode (code, kind, user message, cause, fix, support note, optional HTTP status) implemented by every platform code enum, with the texts kept as data next to each enum (Enum.codes.properties); PlatformError (code, safe message, cause with safe details, reference ID, time); ReferenceId; FailureLog; the generated catalogue docs/errors/platform-error-codes.md and .json.
